blocks.text: A1-10 · L'iḍāfa simple
Lesson overview

⁧وِزَارَةُ الدَّاخِلِيَّةِ⁩ The Ministry of the Interior, ⁧جَامِعَةُ القَاهِرَةِ⁩ The University of Cairo, ⁧مَكْتَبُ المُدِيرِ⁩ The Director's office is: two names placed one after the other, without preposition, express our . È l' iḍāfa ( ⁧إِضَافَة⁩ , () annexation), the building that bears almost all the names of institutions, offices and places. Without iḍāfa You don't read a newspaper headline. In this unity you learn it, distinguish it from the name with adjective and use it with the basic institutional vocabulary. Two weeks; close the form A1.2.

rows: 12–14 hours · two weeks (weeks 26–27 of the calendar)

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A1 (tag A1-10), voice synthesis script, tutor session in the second week
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. form theiḍāfa: first term without article and without tanwīn, second term to the genitive;
2. read the ⁧ة⁩ the first term as -at;
3. to understand when aiḍāfa is determined or indeterminate;
4. add an adjective to aiḍāfa and understand what name it refers to;
5. distinguish iḍāfa and name + adjective ( ⁧جَامِعَةُ القَاهِرَةِ⁩ / ⁧المَتْحَفُ المِصْرِيُّ⁩ ), even without vowels;
6. read signs, headers and short news with names of institutions and summarize them in three sentences.
Two-week plan.

blocks.text: What to notice. In ⁧جَامِعَةُ القَاهِرَةِ⁩ and ⁧شَارِعُ التَّحْرِيرِ⁩ the first name does not have the article, the second yes: it is a 'iḍāfa. In ⁧المَتْحَفُ المِصْرِيُّ⁩ both have the article: it's an adjective name (A1-04). ⁧مَعْنَى⁩ • Meaning: ⁧مَعْنَاهُ⁩ Its meaning is used to ask for the meaning of a word: ⁧مَا مَعْنَى⁩ … ⁧؟⁩
2. How to form theiḍāfa
⁧سَيَّارَةُ أَخِيأَخِيسَيَّارَة⁩ sayyāratu aḫī my brother's car
The three rules.
1. The first term has no article or tanwīn. It is determined by the second, as the name with suffix:
door of the house is said to be "porta la-casa" .
2. The second term is to the genitive: -i if determined, -indeterminately, -a for diptotes without article
( ⁧سَفِيرُ تُونِسَ⁩ ).
3. The first term takes the case required by the sentence: subject -u ( ⁧بَابُ البَيْتِ كَبِيرٌ⁩ ), after preposition -i
( ⁧أَمَامَ بَابِ البَيْتِ⁩ ).

Because that's how it works. L'iḍāfa It's like a name with a suffix, but instead of the suffix there's another name: ⁧كِتَابُهُ⁩ His book is → ⁧كِتَابُ الطَّالِبِ⁩ The student's book is the same as the student's. For this reason, the first name cannot have the article: it is already possessed.
3. The pronunciation of the first term

The ⁧ة⁩ read -at. In the first term, ⁧ة⁩ it is always followed by desinence and the middle name: madīnatu Mīlānū , wizāratu d-dāḫiliyya , ǧāmiʿatu l-Qāhira . Even in the speech without termination, t remains: wizārat ad- dāḫiliyya , ǧāmiʿat al-Qāhira . It's the safest way to recognize aiḍāfa I'm listening. The ligament. The termination of the first term is linked to the article of the second: bābu l-bayt, maktabu l-mudīr . With solar letters: šāriʿu t-taḥrīr , qismu š-šurṭa .
4. Determined or indefinite
⁧صُورَةُ شَارِعٍ⁩ undetermined a photo of a street

L'iḍāfa the whole takes the determination of the second term. With a proper name or suffix it is determined: ⁧سَفِيرُ تُونِسَ⁩ The Ambassador of Tunisia is hereby appointed as Head of Mission of the Republic of Tunisia. ⁧بَيْتُ أَبِي⁩ It's my father's house.
5. Iḍāfa or name with adjective?

No vowels. : ⁧جامعة القاهرة⁩ first word without ⁧الـ⁩ , second with ⁧الـ⁩ → iḍāfa. : ⁧الجامعة الأمريكية⁩ two articles → name + adjective. It is the first analysis to be done on each title. Warning to ⁧الدَّاخِلِيَّة⁩ and ⁧الخَارِجِيَّة⁩ . They are women's nisba used as names: "internal affairs," "external affairs." In ⁧وِزَارَةُ الدَّاخِلِيَّةِ⁩ are the second term of theiḍāfa, to the genitive.
6. Chains
Aiḍāfa can have three or more names. Only the last one can have the article or be a proper name; all previous items are without article; From the second on, they're all to the genitive.
⁧مَكْتَبُ مُدِيرِ الشُّرْطَةِ⁩ maktabu mudīri š-šurṭa the police director's office

rows: the mayor of Milan (Lett. the head of the municipality of Milan)

blocks.text: ⁧بَابُ بَيْتِ صَدِيقِي⁩ bābu bayti ṣadīqī the door of my friend's house
It reads like a block. In a chain there is only one article, in the end: it is a useful signal to find where the nominal group ends up in a long title.
7. Iḍāfa with adjective
The adjective cannot stand in the midst of aiḍāfa: goes after the whole building. It agrees with the name it refers to in general, determination and case: so you understand what name it speaks of.

rows: the new car of the director
the car of the new director
the Italian Minister for the Interior

blocks.text: Without vowels sentences 1 and 2 are distinguished by gender ( ⁧الجديدة⁩ / ⁧الجديد⁩ ); When gender is the same, sometimes it only decides context. It is a real ambiguity of the unvocalized print: signal it when it counts.
8. Institutions and offices

Two comments. In ⁧جَامِعَةُ الدُّوَلِ العَرَبِيَّةِ⁩ the adjective ⁧العَرَبِيَّة⁩ refers to ⁧الدُّوَل⁩ • the statuses (plural of what → female singular, A1-15) * The League of Arab States. Here ⁧جَامِعَة⁩ means "lega" , not "university." The names of the institutions of a country are translated by describing them: "The Italian Ministry of the Interior" is ⁧وِزَارَةُ الدَّاخِلِيَّةِ الإِيطَالِيَّةُ⁩ ; for bodies without a fixed Arab equivalent, the Arabic press uses different periphrases, and should be checked case by case.
9. Pronunciation

-at and the ligament. Read the section table aloud 8 holding t of ⁧ة⁩ and linking termination to the article: wizāratu d-dāḫiliyya . Then read it again in the form of speech without desinence: wizārat ad-dāḫiliyya . ⁧الدِّفَاع⁩ , ⁧الصِّحَّة⁩ . Two šadda: that of the solar letter and that of the word ( ṣiḥḥa ). ⁧ج⁩ in ⁧جُمْهُورِيَّة⁩ , ⁧ء⁩ in ⁧الوُزَرَاء⁩ . ǧumhūriyya (ǧ as in the case of frosted, sucked; wuzarāʾ with the final glottidal occlusion, which you feel before a break.

blocks.text: Notes of use. ⁧مُدِير⁩ has two plurals: ⁧مُدَرَاء⁩ (very used) and ⁧مُدِيرُون⁩ (regular). ⁧مَبْنًى⁩ and ⁧مَعْنًى⁩ follow the model of ⁧مَقْهًى⁩ ( A1-08): with Article ⁧المَبْنَى⁩ , ⁧المَعْنَى⁩ ; with the suffix ⁧مَعْنَاهُ⁩ . ⁧وَزِير⁩ and ⁧رَئِيس⁩ You know them from the Level 0: here they enter the active vocabulary with their plurals.
